description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency publishes the scripts and documentation used to assemble its Emissions & Generation Resource Integrated Database. The code combines plant- and generator-level generation and emissions reports into eGRID tables and regional summaries. Inputs are U.S. federal power-plant reporting sources; outputs are release-ready electricity mix, capacity and emissions metrics. Spatial coverage is the United States and its eGRID regions, while each release uses a stated data year. The repository's source code is free under MIT terms on GitHub. It is a production and data-preparation workflow, not the released data file itself. A limitation is that replicating a release requires the correct upstream reporting files and processing settings; the review did not execute the pipeline or inspect generated values. The workflow can help prepare emission factors and generation-asset attributes for electricity dispatch, capacity and exposure simulations. The catalogue already contains data-epa-egrid-emissions-generation-resource-integrated-database for the resulting public data; this draft records the separate build software.
